text: {"lessons":["I should decide in advance why I would sell a stock; selling Stock B at steep losses in consecutive periods without a clear plan risks making reactive decisions.","I should avoid chasing recent price moves: I bought more Stock C after its price had risen, and should weigh its prospects and portfolio size before adding.","I should judge progress by my whole portfolio and long-term apartment goal, not by one month or one trade; my account value still fell 5.2% in Period 5."]}
